name: Durin
notes: A Pyro off-field sub-DPS whose Burst gives the Dragon attacks that carry the damage (both sources put the Burst first). They agree on 4pc A Day Carved from Rising Winds (KQM's best for personal damage), ATK% Sands, a Pyro DMG or ATK% Goblet, a crit Circlet and Athame Artis and Freedom-Sworn as the first two weapons. Goals are Game8's (ATK 2,000 or above, CR 60-70%, CD 200% or above); Game8 says little ER is needed if his Skill is Crowned, and KQM's table runs 100-150%, so ER 120% is the low end of KQM's no-Pyro-teammate range. The second and third sets (KQM's Noblesse Oblige and Celestial Gift) are support sets for teammates; the third weapon is KQM's Favonius Sword.
